quote: I have memory problems, so I don't pay a lot of bills.
stewart_read: Doug discloses a real vulnerability (memory problems) and the rep responds with a flat procedural reassurance instead of acknowledging it.
coaching_implication: Rep should acknowledge the disclosure briefly ('no problem at all') then explicitly pivot to reaching the wife as primary contact, rather than letting the moment pass silently into the next qualifier.

quote: Well, my wife's it's all the bills.
stewart_read: First signal that the wife is the actual qualifying contact; rep doesn't pause to redirect the call structure toward her at this point.
alternative_hypothesis: Rep may have intended to keep gathering what he could from Doug before switching contacts — but nothing in the transcript supports this as deliberate; he simply continues the script.
coaching_implication: Should have asked immediately: 'Is she available, or should we set this up directly with her?'

quote: Well, it kinda depends on what day.
stewart_read: Scheduling attempt with the wrong person produces an unusable answer; the rep doesn't anchor a firm day/time and instead lets the conversation drift into a vague later-today callback.
coaching_implication: Rep should stop trying to schedule through Doug and directly ask for a specific callback window to reach the wife, e.g., 'What time this evening is best to call her?'

quote: Perfect. And then you said your wife paid it. She's not sure how much.
stewart_read: No bill number was ever captured; rep files the non-answer and moves straight to the credit qualifier instead of anchoring on the retirement/fixed-income pain already surfaced.
coaching_implication: Even without a number, rep could tie back to Doug's own words ('you mentioned being on a limited income — that's exactly why getting the actual bill matters') to keep the pain alive.

stewart_read: Fixed income + large home/shop footprint (1,500 sqft house, 1,500 sqft shop) is a strong qualifying signal for bill pain, but the rep doesn't expand on it.
coaching_implication: Rep should have asked a follow-up about the shop's energy use specifically — a second structure often means higher usage and stronger solar case.

quote: I'll give her a call and set something up for you guys. Okay?
stewart_read: Call ends with a promise to call the wife rather than any locked appointment element (time, one-hour block, is-that-fair handshake).
coaching_implication: Rep should have secured a specific callback window before ending ('I'll call her at 5pm today — does that work?') rather than the open 'later in the day.'
